optimized_sql:
WITH person_info_matches AS (
    SELECT pi.person_id
    FROM info_type AS it
    JOIN person_info AS pi ON it.id = pi.info_type_id
    WHERE it.info = 'mini biography'
      AND pi.note = 'Volker Boehm'
),
prefiltered_titles AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    WHERE t.production_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1984
)
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS of_person, MIN(t.title) AS biography_movie
FROM person_info_matches AS pim
JOIN name AS n
    ON n.id = pim.person_id
    AND n.name_pcode_cf LIKE 'D%'
    AND n.gender = 'm'
JOIN aka_name AS an
    ON an.person_id = n.id
    AND an.name LIKE '%a%'
JOIN cast_info AS ci
    ON ci.person_id = n.id
JOIN movie_link AS ml
    ON ml.linked_movie_id = ci.movie_id
JOIN link_type AS lt
    ON lt.id = ml.link_type_id
    AND lt.link = 'features'
JOIN prefiltered_titles AS t
    ON t.id = ci.movie_id
    AND t.id = ml.linked_movie_id
